website.reason: This release changes installed runtime behavior and an in-product privacy setting; existing website pages do not contain version-specific claims that require an update.

socialPost.text:
NextClaw v0.41.0 is out.

Product analytics are off by default and can exclude team/QA traffic. Desktop Service Apps now use NextClaw’s bundled Node, so Favorites and Calendar work without a system Node install.

https://docs.nextclaw.io/en/notes/2026-08-20-nextclaw-v0-41-0
